description: This Java source file defines an Android Activity 'FragmentAlertDialog' that demonstrates displaying an AlertDialog managed by a DialogFragment. It includes methods for showing the dialog and handling positive/negative button clicks, as well as the nested static class 'MyAlertDialogFragment' which creates and manages the alert dialog UI.

classes.name: FragmentAlertDialog
classes.description: Main activity demonstrating AlertDialog with a DialogFragment.

classes.name: MyAlertDialogFragment
classes.description: Nested static class extending DialogFragment to create and display an alert dialog.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes activity, sets layout, and sets button click handler to show dialog.

methods.name: showDialog
methods.description: Creates and shows an instance of MyAlertDialogFragment with specified title.

methods.name: doPositiveClick
methods.description: Handles the positive button click in the dialog; logs the event.

methods.name: doNegativeClick
methods.description: Handles the negative button click in the dialog; logs the event.
